Two uniform spheres A and B, of equal radius, are at rest on a smooth horizontal table. Sphere A
has mass 3m and sphere B has mass m. Sphere A is projected directly towards B, with speed u. The
coefficient of restitution between the spheres is 0.6. Find the speeds of A and B after they collide.
Sphere B now strikes a wall that is perpendicular to its path, rebounds and collides with A again. The
coefficient of restitution between B and the wall is e. Given that the second collision between A and
B brings A to rest, find e. [5]
